A music-hall exhibition fighter who earns the crowd's acclaim in battle and spends it on devastating bouts.

SKILLS

OPENING STATEMENT · SL max 2

At the start of a conflict, you may spend 2 Acclaim to form a Bond with up to (SL) strength with a creature you can see. This Bond does not count towards the total Bonds you may have and only lasts for the conflict.

CROWD FAVOURITE · SL max 3

When you enter a settlement, you may spend up to all your current Acclaim to declare you have a fan club there. A fan club is a group of NPCs devoted to your actions and persona. They are willing to cover expenses or perform services up to a total cost of ((SL + Acclaim Spent) × 30) zenit while you are in the settlement. These services may be the ones found on pg.125 of the Core Rulebook, or other services you and your group may find appropriate. You can change this limit by spending Acclaim again the next time you enter a settlement with a fan club.

You gain (SL × 2) Acclaim after resting in a settlement where you have a fan club.

When you successfully perform a Check to fill or erase sections of a Clock, if your approach relied on flair, panache, rabble rousing, or proudly showing off your physique, you may spend 1 Acclaim to fill or erase an additional section of that Clock.

IRON GRIP · SL max 3

You may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to perform an Opposed (MIG + DEX) or (MIG + MIG) Check against a creature you can touch. If you succeed, you grapple your target: your target cannot leave the scene until you let go of them (no action required), you drop to 0 HP, they successfully fill a 4-second clock with the goal of escaping your grapple, or they use an Ultima Point to safely leave the scene.

Grappled targets are always valid targets for your attacks and finishers and you gain a bonus to Accuracy and Opposed Checks against them equal to (SL).

ACCLAIM · SL max 5

When you take damage, hit using a melee weapon, or succeed on a Check (excluding Accuracy Checks) that relies on Might or Willpower, you gain 1 Acclaim. You also gain (SL + 1) Acclaim when you invoke your Traits or Bonds. You lose half your current Acclaim when you rest (to a minimum of 1).

You may use an action to perform a finisher with your choice of flairs (found further in this document), spending as much Acclaim as you have. Each time you acquire this Skill, learn 2 flairs.

You may hold a maximum of (SL) Acclaim at once. Your Acclaim is bound to your active Guise: it persists from scene to scene while you wear that Guise, but it is tied to that Guise and does not carry across a change of Guise or mask.

EXHIBITION BOUTS

A Finisher is a high-octane powermove a Strongman does when they want to close out a fight. Finishers are generally unique to each strongman, being given names by their users reflective of their effects or their user's personality.

Before you perform a finisher, you must pick which base your finisher uses: the base is what your finisher generally looks like and will determine the Check needed to perform it. Once you've picked your base, you can spend additional Acclaim to tack on flairs, extra effects that help a finisher feel distinct and powerful.

Once you've settled on your base and your flairs, you can now unleash your finisher upon your enemies! The damage calculation for finishers is (HR + Total Acclaim Spent) physical damage, or the damage type of the weapon used in the finisher, if applicable.

Each base has a Acclaim requirement in order to use them for your finisher, but you can spend additional Acclaim on the base itself to increase its damage, up to a total of 10 Acclaim spent on the base alone.

Acrobatic — Requirement: 3 Acclaim You perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped. This attack may target lying creatures. On a hit, you deal only the finisher's damage, and you may choose to have one of the following effects occur:

  • Your high-lying antics grant you and yours a tailwind: you and your allies may perform another Initiative Group Check with you as the leader, using the new result at the start of the next round.
  • An atmospheric danger or hazard in the area is temporarily cleared for the scene.

Hold — Requirement: 2 Acclaim You perform an Opposed (MIG + DEX) Check against your target. If you succeed, your target takes damage, is grappled according to the rules in the Iron Grip Skill, and you may choose to have one of the following effects occur:

  • You lock out your opponent's general mobility: choose a basic attack, spell, or other action your target can use. Until the end of your next turn, your target cannot use that attack, spell, or other action.
  • You may ask one question about your target's external anatomy or skeletal structure, or whatever it has that is analogous to a skeleton. Your Game Master must answer truthfully.

Strike — Requirement: 2 Acclaim You perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped. On a hit, you deal only the finisher's damage and you may choose to have one of the following effects occur:

  • You flow into a combo: you may perform another free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped, treating your HR as 0 when calculating damage for this attack. This attack does not count as a finisher.
  • Tag team; you may choose an ally and have them perform a free attack against the creature you just hit, treating their HR as 0 when calculating damage for their attack. This attack does not count as a finisher.

Takedown — Requirement: 3 Acclaim You perform an Opposed (MIG + MIG) Check against your target. If you succeed, your target takes damage and you may choose to have one of the following effects occur:

  • Your target is knocked out cold: they perform one less action (to a minimum of 0 actions) during their next turn.
  • The area in the current scene is altered due to the force of your takedown. Work with the GM on how your surroundings have changed and what possible effects these changes may have.

The following are flairs you can add to a finisher base in order to customize its effects. A flair will indicate if you can spend more than 1 Acclaim on it, with others requiring you to do so before you can add their effects into the finisher.

Atomic — Requirement: 1 Acclaim The finisher's damage type changes from its original type to your choice of either bolt, fire, or light.

Avenging — Requirement: 3 Acclaim This flair lets you perform the finisher on another creature's turn when an ally is targeted by an attack, spell, or other harmful effect.

Brilliant — Requirement: 1 Acclaim When you add this flair, choose any number of creatures that can see you. You spend 1 Acclaim for each creature chosen. After performing the finisher, if your target's current Willpower die size is smaller than yours, then they have a -2 to Accuracy and Magic Checks until the start of your next turn.

Crowd Pleaser — Requirement: 2 Acclaim You may add the number of Bonds you have to the finisher's damage calculation.

Dedicated — Requirement: 1 Acclaim Choose an ally that you have a Bond with. After performing the finisher, that ally deals additional damage or recovers additional HP or MP equal to (the strength of your Bond with them, multiplied by 3) the next time they do so.

Double Edge — Requirement: 3 Acclaim You do not include Acclaim spent on this flair in the finisher's damage calculation; instead, each Acclaim spent on this flair adds an additional 5 damage to the finisher, but you must lose HP equal to half the finisher's total damage.

Evil — Requirement: 1 Acclaim The finisher's damage type changes from its original type to your choice of either dark or poison.

Explosive — Requirement: 3 Acclaim Choose one creature for each Acclaim spent on this flair. Your target takes half the finisher's damage. The finisher's other effects only apply to the original target

Greedy — Requirement: 3 Acclaim When you deal damage with a finisher that has this flair, you earn zenit depending on the damage dealt and how much Acclaim you spent on this flair:

  • 1 Acclaim: (Total Damage Dealt) zenit
  • 2 Acclaim: (Total Damage Dealt × 2) zenit
  • 3 Acclaim: (Total Damage Dealt × 3) zenit

Of Love — Requirement: 1 Acclaim If you have a Bond of Admiration, Loyalty, or Affection with a creature in the scene, your target suffers either slow or weak (your choice).

Passionate — Requirement: Special When you add this flair, choose allies that can see or hear you. You spend 1 Acclaim for each ally chosen. After performing the finisher, those allies treat their Bonds as having 1 additional strength (to a maximum of 4) until the end of the scene.

Planetary — Requirement: 1 Acclaim The finisher's damage type changes from its original type to your choice of either air, earth or ice.

Powerful — Requirement: Special This flair lets you spend more Acclaim to increase the finisher's damage. You can spend a maximum of 10 Acclaim that way.

Pumped — Requirement: 3 Acclaim When you add this flair, choose one Attribute. After you perform the finisher, you treat that Attribute as one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12) until the end of your next turn.

Punishing — Requirement: Special Acclaim spent on this flair does not count towards the finisher's damage calculation; instead, each Acclaim spent on this flair allows you to suffer one of either dazed, shaken, slow, or weak in order to add 3 additional damage to the finisher's damage calculation. This flair has no effect if you were already suffering from one of the mentioned status effects. You can spend a maximum of 4 Acclaim that way.

Quick Change — Requirement: 2 Acclaim Allows you to take the Equipment action before or after performing the finisher, and allows you to change your armor when you take the Equipment action this way.

Showstopping — Requirement: 3 Acclaim If the finisher reduces the target to 0 HP, you gain a Fabula Point.

Technical — Requirement: Special Acclaim spent on this flair does not count towards the finisher's damage calculation, but instead is added as a bonus to the Check associated with the finisher. You can spend a maximum of 3 Acclaim that way.

Wrathful — Requirement: 1 Acclaim If you have a Bond of Inferiority, Mistrust, or Hatred with your target, they suffer either dazed or shaken (your choice).

X-Slaying — Requirement: Special When you add this flair, choose a Species. For every 2 Acclaim you spend on this flair, the finisher ignores certain Damage Affinities your target has if they belong to the Species you chose. Acclaim Spent / Bypassed Damage Affinity: 2 — Resistance; 4 — Immunities; 6 — Absorptions
